_comment: BT 15 longitudinal notebook journey. SYNTHETIC. Each step is an action through the real repository functions or HTTP routes, with the expected notebook state after it. Written from docs/BUTLER_INVESTOR_MEMORY.md, not from the code. Dates are offsets in days from the journey start (day 0 = opt-in). Evaluate correction handling and false-pattern suggestions, never agreement with Butler or trading profit. Not yet a test: a test-writing pass should drive these steps on a disposable database (app/db/scratch.py) and assert each 'expect'.

steps.why: Off by default; signup, imports and follows never opt anyone in.
No consent: nothing is captured, even by a worker pass.
No retrospective backfill without an explicit date.
One episode is not a trait; a fluent answer is recorded, not checked.
Repeated copies of one episode never count toward the threshold.

args.answer: A rehearsed, well-written paragraph with no dated observation.

steps.why: WHAT_WOULD_FALSIFY_THIS_NOW is answer-satisfied; persuasion cannot reach CHECKED_BY_CODE.
Improvement is tracked as carefully as the lapse.
Genuine improvement retires assertive coaching without any user action.
A correction takes effect on the next read, before any worker pass.

args.note: I answer this outside the app.

steps.why: Disagreement stops personality-directed prompts; it is never evidence of defensiveness.
Financial and factual checks are identical with or without the notebook.
90 days without a fresh eligible episode -> stale, not deleted.
An ALL_BEFORE exclusion stops deleted material from being rebuilt by a backfill.
Report/profile isolation (report_contract.forbid_notebook_keys; make lint import wall).

cross_cutting.check: Runner and scheduler roles have no SELECT on any notebook table (053 grants).
Another investor/user reading this notebook gets the scoped 404/403, never rows (RLS + ownership).
The engine role cannot write consent, self-descriptions, controls or exclusions; the human role cannot write episodes, patterns or revisions.
A pattern revision with faked counts, a REPEATED status under threshold, or a cited episode of the wrong polarity/catalogue is refused by 053.
Reflection packet contains ids, codes and dates only -- no note, answer, thesis or chat text.
A reflection proposal naming an unknown catalogue id (e.g. a diagnosis label) is rejected whole; deterministic revisions stand.
Plus (trackr-frontend) and packages/ contain no notebook client (make lint).
